gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kharos: Stencil bridges and tall lowercase give Snowburst One a loud, expressive look right away. Noto Sans Kharoshthi backs it with curves that never close back on themselves, and a dark stripe of lowercase.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Expressive stencil bridges and tall lowercase define Snowburst One, while Noto Sans Khmer keeps its small letters proud and nearly capital-sized. The heading shouts in stencil cuts; the body just reads, with generous openings.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kr: Bold describes Snowburst One, a stencil sheet with tall lowercase. Noto Sans KR takes the quieter job, keeping stubby ascenders beside a large x-height and curves that stay generously open.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-malaya: Stenciled, tall and expressive, Snowburst One grabs the eye with its wide bridges between letters. But Noto Sans Malayalam fills the line's middle zone and opens its s generously, a friendly sans against the shout.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-mandai: Noto Sans Mandaic keeps its lowercase rising close to capitals and its curves loose, under the stencil-cut Snowburst One. Loud tall heading, loosely curved body: that tension is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-meroit: Wide stencil bridges between letters give Snowburst One its loud, cut-paper personality. And Noto Sans Meroitic sits quietly underneath, filling each line with see-through c openings and capital-like lowercase.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-modi: Snowburst One arrives as a stencil sheet, wide-bridged and tall in the lowercase. Noto Sans Modi, a sans-serif with daylight inside every curve and little gap between capital and body height, is its steady counterweight.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-mro: A sprung-paper-clip opening and wide stencil bridges set Snowburst One apart at the top. And Noto Sans Mro fills the space below with dense, tall-looking words and wide entrances into each letter.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-multan: Tall lowercase and stencil-wide bridges give Snowburst One a bold, expressive face. But Noto Sans Multani, a sans-serif with a lofty x-height and an e left wide at the terminal, keeps things easygoing.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-myanma: Dense and dark through the middle, Noto Sans Myanmar carries a broad, welcoming c beneath the stencil cuts of Snowburst One. Loud above, sturdy below, and oddly friendly about it.
